publicPromptHygiene.policy: Captured public community prompts preserve third-party handles, plates, addresses, domains, promo codes and upload filenames verbatim by owner decision. Byte-exactness forbids redacting in place; this inventory does not change publication.
publicPromptHygiene.method: scripts/lib/public-prompt-hygiene.mjs scans raw text for named @handles and lowercase dotted social handles (excluding reference slots), domains/URLs, postal-code-plus-street addresses, numbered license plates, promotional codes and upload filenames. Pattern matches are candidates, not identity verification or a guarantee that all such text is detectable.

source-reference-gaps.policy: These rows are exact as published but incomplete by origin: source feeds delete reference mentions. Keep their captured bytes and informational compatibility flags unchanged. The owner may hide them.
source-reference-gaps.method: scripts/lib/source-reference-gaps.mjs detects orphaned reference connectors, empty assignments and missing subjects, and records capture input-asset counts where available. Counts corroborate gaps; upload totals alone do not imply missing text. This is a conservative text-pattern inventory, not a completeness guarantee.

records.name: ON THE WAVE
records.prompt:
@image1 — character reference. Exact face and body preserved 100% in every frame. The girl wears a red one-piece swimsuit.
FORMAT: Hyper-cinematic image-to-video, 15 seconds, 16:9, 4K, 24 fps. One continuous single-take shot — absolutely no cuts, no hidden cuts, no transitions, no editing.
LOCATION: A tropical island in the open ocean, bright midday golden sun, deep turquoise water, a white sandy beach, lush green palm trees, powerful rolling waves, sea spray, sun glints on the surface. An epic, raw, cinematic atmosphere.
SHOT SEQUENCE:
[0–5s] AERIAL APPROACH. The camera flies fast from high altitude over the ocean toward a small tropical island. A sweeping drone pass along the coastline reveals turquoise reefs, the white beach, the palm trees. Then the camera smoothly descends toward the water near the shore, where the girl from Image 1 in a red one-piece swimsuit is already paddling a white surfboard through the waves, her face precisely matching @image1.
[5–9s] DESCENT INTO THE CHASE. The camera drops to water level and locks into a low chase position behind and slightly to the side of her surfboard. She paddles powerfully, then pops up onto her feet and catches a rising wave. Spray flies out around the board. The camera stays close, at board height, following from behind.
[9–15s] EPIC SURF ACTION. She carves aggressively across the wave face at high speed in a deep crouch, one hand skimming the water, throwing up a fan of spray. She hits a steep section and launches a stylish aerial off the crest — grabbing the surfboard rail mid-air, droplets hanging suspended around her, a brief dramatic slow-motion beat. She lands cleanly with a powerful explosion of spray toward the lens, then accelerates onward into the next wave. The shot ends in motion at full speed.
CAMERA: One continuous movement — high aerial approach → orbit around the island → smooth descent to the water → locking in low behind the surfboard → chase through the aerial and the landing. Anamorphic 24mm equivalent, T2.8, natural motion blur, water droplets on the lens after entering the wave.
STYLE: Large-format aerial cinematography meets an extreme-sports film. Photorealistic live-action. 35mm film grain, 6%, a deep rich turquoise-and-gold color grade, anamorphic flares, cinematic glow in the highlights.
SOUND:
[0–5s] Distant wind, ocean ambience, a low cinematic score building tension.
[5–9s] Splashes from paddle strokes, the board slapping against the water, wind rushing past the lens.
[9–15s] The roar of the wave, the surfboard cutting through the water, impacts of spray, a muffled whoosh during the aerial, a hard splash on landing, a powerful cinematic musical swell.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: cuts, hidden cuts, transitions, editing, identity distortion, a different face, wrong swimsuit color, bikini, two-piece swimsuit, deformed hands, extra fingers, disappearing surfboard, feet separating from the board, distorted anatomy, cartoon, animation, plastic CGI look, watermark, text, subtitles, logos.

records.name: RED CRYSTAL AMULET
records.prompt: A continuous cinematic fantasy action sequence of a young warrior woman (match the uploaded reference — same face, hair and build 100%). She is crawling across a rain-lashed obsidian battlefield, desperately holding up a jagged shard-shaped red crystal amulet set in a black iron talon. Suddenly, a massive surge of crimson lightning explodes from the crystal, instantly splitting the sky and turning the entire landscape into a storm-torn wasteland of shattered towers and electrified black glass. The woman is wrenched high into the air as violent, forking vortices of red lightning wrap around her body. In mid-air, the electricity materializes into a highly detailed crimson and black fantasy battle dress with dark chrome arm guards and a storm-tattered cape. A crackling crown of pure red lightning arcs above her brow, and her eyes snap open, glowing with intense, searing bolt-shaped patterns. She raises her hand to summon an intricate, giant blood-red magical circle of rotating lightning-glyphs in front of her, unleashing a catastrophic, blinding discharge of red lightning that obliterates everything in sight. 8K ultra-realism, high-fidelity VFX, dynamic camera angles, cinematic lighting, and epic scale.
